final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_by_station FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as global_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT s1.observstation, s1.avg_by_station, s1.avg_by_station - s2.global_avg as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.global_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_by_station > s2.global_avg ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
